data.name: Ghanim
data.gender_notes: Ghanim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghanana', which means to gain or acquire. In Islamic context, Ghanim represents the idea of being rich in blessings, generosity, and provision from Allah. The name Ghanim carries the meaning “Generous, Provision, Rich” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghanim usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, provision, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the abundance and generosity of Allah
data.etymology: Ghanim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Provision, Rich.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghanim total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: غَنِيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: الغَنِيمُ: المُستَغْنِي مِنَ الدُنْيَا، مَنِ اِستَغْنى بِاللَهِ عَنِ الدُنْيَا، وَغَيرُهُ فَقِيرٌ، وَغَنِيمُ الرِزْقِ: مَنِ اِستَفادَ مِنَ الدُنْيَا بِاللَهِ، وَغَيرُهُ فَقِيرٌ، وَإِنَّما يَستَغِنِي مِنَ الدُنْيَا مَنِ اِستَعانَ بِاللَهِ عَلَيها، وَإِنّي أُقيمُ لِللَهِ مُستَغِنىً مِنَ الدُنْيَا، غَنِيمُ اللَهِ

in_urdu.name: غانم
in_urdu.meaning: غانم کا مطلب غریبوں سے بچنا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: غانم کا لفظ عربي زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جو غریبوں سے بچنے والا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ سے معصوم ہے، اس سے زیادہ دولت یا مال حاصل نہیں ہوتا، بلکہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی رحمت اور بخشش سے دولت حاصل ہوتی ہے، اسی طرح اللہ تعالیٰ کے وصال سے غانم ہوتا ہے، جب کہ باقی لوگ غریبوں میں ہیں۔

in_english.name: Ghanim
in_english.meaning: Ghanim means a person who is blessed with abundant wealth and resources
in_english.long_meaning: Ghanim is a name derived from the Arabic root word 'ghanima', which means 'to be rich' or 'to be prosperous'. A person named Ghanim is one who is blessed with abundant wealth and resources, not just material wealth, but also spiritual wealth. The name Ghanim signifies a person who is content with what Allah has given him, and is not greedy for more. It is a name that reflects the Islamic value of contentment and gratitude towards Allah's blessings. In Islamic tradition, Ghanim is considered a blessed name, as it reminds the bearer to be thankful for what they have, and not to take their blessings for granted.
